tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, Git, code reviews and agile teams.

cover_en.subject: Application: [Post] Ambika Sandhil
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the [Post] Ambika Sandhil role. With over 5 years of professional experience building and supporting enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in SAP Commerce Cloud and Java backend development.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Cloud & Java
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring for Rockwell Automation.

bullets.label: REST APIs & Integrations
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and customized Interceptors, Populators and Converters for custom data flows.

bullets.label: Platform & DevOps
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) within agile DevOps workflows at Shell.

bullets.label: Database Optimization
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and improved transaction speed during my work at Shell.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am currently serving my notice period with a last working day on 15/12/2026, and I am available to start on 16/12/2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my background aligns with your team.

tailoring.why_company: I am eager to contribute my 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud and Java backend expertise to Ambika Sandhil. Having built and supported large-scale enterprise e-commerce platforms for global clients like Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am well-equipped to deliver robust APIs, optimize database performance, and support seamless integrations within your agile team.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud and Java backend expertise to build, scale, and optimize enterprise e-commerce platforms.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I am an SAP Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I noticed your opening for [Post] Ambika Sandhil and would love to connect. I hold a valid German work permit and am available starting December 16, 2026.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for [Post] Ambika Sandhil – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the [Post] Ambika Sandhil position. With over 5 years of professional experience as an SAP Commerce Cloud and Java Developer at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong expertise in enterprise e-commerce, OCC REST APIs, and platform optimization. I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid German work permit and am available to start on December 16, 2026. I look forward to the possibility of discussing my application with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
